text.en:
To further accelerate the attainment of the objective set forth in the Presidential Decree No. 27,
the following provisions are hereby incorporated, to wit;
1. The landowner shall be exempt from the capital gains tax on the proceeds of the amortizations paid him by
the tenant-purchaser and likewise from income tax due on the securing interests paid as an addition to the total
cost of the land.
2. The active participation of rural banks and all other financial institutions shall be required in order to
provide immediate sources of funds to augment loans/credits to be made available to the tenants and/or
farmers cooperatives inconsistent with the asserted implementation of the supervised credit program.
3. The Agricultural Guarantee Fund constituted under Section twelve of Republic Act 6390 for all its intent
and purpose include the guarantee coverage to the participating financial institutions under the same terms and
conditions allowed and applied to the rural banking system.
4. The existing agricultural guarantee loan funds wholly or partly contributed and/or funded by government
agencies shall be integrated into the Agricultural Guarantee Fund, and shall be governed by the rules and
regulations promulgated by the Agricultural Guarantee Fund Board established under Section thirteen of the
mentioned Act.

All acts, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, inconsistent herewith are amended or
modified accordingly.
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
